text:
mira-support: Heads-up — HelixHealth (prod) reporting shorter, clipped answers after our 4.0 quant rollout. They say the assistant stops mid-instruction and no longer offers next-step suggestions.

mira-support: Customer says it started after we switched traffic to rwd/model-4.0.0-quant on 2026-03-12. No HTTP errors, auth/billing fine. Severity: impacting support workflows.

mira-support: Minimal repro they used: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/model-4.0.0-quant","input":"User: I received an unexpected charge on my account. Can you walk me through how to dispute it?\nAssistant:"}'
```

mira-support: Before rollout (HelixHealth logs):
```
Assistant: I'm sorry to hear that. To dispute a charge, go to Billing > Transactions, find the charge, click 'Report an issue', and fill the form. I can draft an email or walk you through each field. Do you have the transaction ID?
```

mira-support: After rollout (HelixHealth logs):
```
Assistant: Go to Billing > Transactions. Click \"Report an issue.\"
```

tony-eng: Can you paste request_id and the exact route they hit? Also which sampling params?

mira-support: req_b7c4e9a4. Route: /v1/generate. Params: temperature=0.0, max_tokens=80, top_p=1.0.

sam-ml: Logs snippet from our side: 
```
[2026-03-12T18:12:09Z] req=req_b7c4e9a4 model=rwd/model-4.0.0-quant route=generate status=200 latency=72ms tokens_out=9
[2026-03-12T18:12:09Z] prompt_len=32 kv_cache_miss=0 quant_bits=8 stop_score=0.0
```

sam-ml: tokens_out=9 while max_tokens=80 — suggests early termination. I also see the sampling loop sees an all-zero logits vector for one step on the quant kernel path.

tony-eng: We rolled a new quant kernel selection rule in the optimizer on 2026-03-11 (canary). Possible kernel-induced numerical artifact.

clare-pm: Customer impact high — product team needs ETA. They have a scheduled demo Friday. Consider temporary mitigation.

mira-support: I offered to pin HelixHealth to rwd/model-4.0.0-fp16 if capacity allows; they accepted provisional pin.

tony-eng: Good. I'll open an incident/priority bug and add a regression test. Sam, can you run a diff on generated length distribution between quant and fp16 artifacts? Include prompts ending with punctuation, colon, and short single-line prompts.

sam-ml: On it. Early results: quant artifact emits end-of-sequence token prematurely when the final logits have tiny negative values that the quantized kernel rounds to exact zero. Sampling code treats zero as strong signal for EOS in our current thresholding logic.

tony-eng: That explains the missing clarifying questions. Proposed fix: change EOS detection to use relative logit thresholds and ignore single-step exact-zero anomalies coming from quant kernels. Will prepare PR.

deploy-bot: Rollout timeline: rwd/model-4.0.0-quant canary started 2026-03-11T20:10Z (30%); full rollout 2026-03-12T17:50Z.

clare-pm: Action items: (1) Pin HelixHealth to fp16 (mira to confirm), (2) sam & tony to produce fix PR + regression tests, (3) produce customer-facing summary and ETA.

mira-support: Customer pinned. They sent a batch of 12 prompt examples; forwarding to eng now.

sam-ml: PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5012 — includes stop-token threshold changes and new unit tests with quantized kernels. Preliminary eval shows restored length distribution across checks.

tony-eng: After QA, we'll push hotfix to canary and validate HelixHealth's examples before rolling full fix. If needed, keep customer pinned until patch is verified.

mira-support: Customer notified and grateful for the quick pin. Will follow-up if they notice any remaining terse replies.

clare-pm: Thanks team — mark hotfix high priority. Update ticket with PR link and ETA once QA completes.
